MsBackendMzPeak 0.97.0
  • Reference

mzPeak file format support for Spectra

This repository provides a backend for Spectra objects to read data from the HUPO-PSI mzPeak file format for MS data.

Installation

The package can be installed with

install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("RforMassSpectrometry/MsBackendMzPeak")

Contributions

Contributions are highly welcome and should follow the contribution guidelines. Also, please check the coding style guidelines in the RforMassSpectrometry vignette.
